title: Vallée's assessment of the Billy Meier photos

tellings.quote: but Jacqu Valet has looked at some of these photos.

plain: The UFO researcher Jacques Vallée has examined some of the photographs taken in Switzerland in the late 1970s by Billy Meier, a Swiss man who says his pictures show craft flown by visitors from elsewhere. The philosopher Jason Jorjani brings this up with Michels, passing on Vallée's look at the photos, though in what he says here he does not spell out what Vallée concluded. It matters because a careful researcher's verdict would weigh heavily on whether the pictures are real.
